notes: Two-stage food pipeline: GGCD YOLOv8n INT8 for 241-class food detection, EfficientNet-Lite0 INT8 for 335-class food classification. All detection classes are food-specific (no COCO filtering needed). NMS is performed in JavaScript, not baked into models.

models.name: GGCD YOLOv8n (241-Class Food Detection)
models.description: YOLOv8n trained on Global Gastronomic Culinary Dataset. 241 food-specific classes spanning Central Asian, South Asian, East Asian, Middle Eastern, European, and American cuisines. INT8 quantized for mobile. NMS performed in JavaScript.

models.name: EfficientNet-Lite0 (335-Class Food Classifier)
models.description: Custom-trained EfficientNet-Lite0 on Food-101 + UEC-256 merged dataset. 335 food-specific classes, 74.17% top-1, 92.14% top-5. INT8 quantized.
